title: Path containment and L3 edit scope units
scenario: 1) isContainedPath(root, x) for x = root, root/a.jar, root/../x, root-evil/a.jar, root/sub/../a.jar, and a different drive on win32. 2) On samples/first-test.json text, findTypeJsonPath for an entity, relation, change-request URI and an unknown URI; replaceLifecycleActions with a proposal.
expected: 1) false for root itself, outside, sibling-prefix and different-drive paths; true for nested and normalized in-root paths. 2) Path is [collection, index, 'lifecycleActions'] or undefined; edited text differs only inside that type's lifecycleActions and still parses as JSON.

title: Deploy plan args and .env placeholder handling units
scenario: 1) buildDeployPlan aws with a .zip in the working dir, function hcp-before-save, .env with AWS_REGION and AWS_PROFILE. 2) buildDeployPlan gcp with GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT and GOOGLE_CLOUD_REGION=us-central1. 3) presentEnvKeys on AWS_PROFILE=your-profile, AWS_REGION=<region>, GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=changeme, quoted empty value, comments, lines without '=', plus a real value.
expected: 1) ok true; aws lambda update-function-code --function-name hcp-before-save --zip-file fileb://<abs artifact>; summary has no credential values. 2) gcloud functions deploy <name> --gen2 --region us-central1 --source <artifact dir>; cwd is the resolved working directory. 3) Only real-valued keys returned; placeholders, empty, quoted-empty, comment and malformed lines skipped; key names only, never values.

source: src/lca/projectPath.ts tenantRootFromConfig + src/lca/hooks.ts validateHook, hooksForKind + src/lca/lifecycleConfig.ts proposeLifecycleChange + src/lca/tenantGate.ts isTenantL3Path, isComponentConfigPath
title: Tenant root, hook, lifecycle proposal and L3 path units
scenario: 1) tenantRootFromConfig for <t>/Business Config/BusinessConfig.json, <t>/L3.reltio.json, a file under a dir with .reltio-config-source.json, and a path with no marker. 2) validateHook and hooksForKind for entity validate, relation validate/beforeSave, changeRequest afterDCRSave/beforeSave, 'beforesave', 'bogus'. 3) proposeLifecycleChange for add, filter, duplicate add, remove (string, inside {actions, filter}, last entry, missing), replace, add with no action. 4) isTenantL3Path and isComponentConfigPath on /samples/, /velocity-packs/, a lookalike name, backslash paths and valid layouts.
expected: 1) <t> for the first two, marker directory for the third (up to 8 levels), file dirname if no marker. 2) Only listed combos ok; case-sensitive message for wrong case or unknown names; relation list excludes validate; DCR list is afterDCRSave only. 3) Duplicate and missing give ok false with proposed equal to current; removing last entry deletes the hook key; replace is destructive; input never mutated; incomplete op reports incomplete. 4) Samples, packs and lookalikes false; backslash paths normalized; valid paths true.

source: src/lca/deployPlan.ts buildDeployPlan + src/lca/deployPlan.ts + envCheck.ts missingEnvKeys + src/lca/workflow.ts deployFailureGuidance, redactSecrets
title: Deploy refusals and failure guidance without leaking secrets
scenario: 1) buildDeployPlan with provider azure, then native, otherwise valid. 2) buildDeployPlan aws with .env 'AWS_REGION=us-east-1' only, then AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=AKIA... without secret key, then ASIA... without AWS_SESSION_TOKEN. 3) deployFailureGuidance on ExpiredToken, InvalidClientTokenId, AccessDenied/403, ResourceNotFound and an unknown error, each containing aws_secret_access_key=abc.
expected: 1) ok false for both with Azure-unresolved / native-no-cloud-CLI messages; no plan or env returned. 2) ok false with missing naming AWS_PROFILE or AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN respectively; no .env value in the message. 3) error shows [redacted]; nextAction differs per class and says not to paste secrets; unknown case says do not update L3 until deploy succeeds.

title: Approval detection and ordered generate/deploy/L3 gates
scenario: 1) isExplicitApproval and classifyTurn on 'yes', 'yes but wait', 'yes?', 'ok deploy it', 'yes update L3', 'What does beforeSave do?', 'Generate an LCA for HCP beforeSave'. 2) Drive createWorkflow through gate(generate/deploy/updateL3) for validation-only, register, missing requirements, unconfirmed attributes, unapproved design, non-Java, then each approval in order.
expected: 1) Only plain affirmations are approvals; caveat, question and deploy/L3 forms are not; questions classify as ask; generate and deploy requests classify as generate and deploy. 2) Each gate stays closed until its prior confirmation is set; deploy needs DEPLOYMENT_PENDING plus approval; updateL3 also needs connectivity confirmed; messages name the missing step.

title: Type/attribute lookup misses and physical config check
scenario: 1) resolveObjectType with 'CourseTopics' (near miss), wrong case 'hcp', a name in two collections, and a kind filter; resolveAttributes with a nested path and a missing name. 2) assessPhysicalAccess for aws (12-digit account, role arn, region, externalId), gcp, azure (entra and oauth forms), placeholder project, undefined text and invalid JSON.
expected: 1) Exact name or label match (case-insensitive) resolves; ambiguous returns ok false with URIs; misses list at most 25 suggestions, near matches first; all missing attributes named. 2) present true only with complete fields; otherwise present false with a console-update instruction; output never includes config values.

title: Manual: reltio.lcaDeploy and reltio.lcaApplyLifecycleActions guards (Tier C)
scenario: 1) Manual QA of reltio.lcaDeploy from the palette with no approved context, azure context, no jar/zip, aws missing on PATH, and a failing CLI exit. 2) Manual QA of reltio.lcaApplyLifecycleActions with approved L3_UPDATE context: cancel the modal, then accept; also a context whose workingDirectory is outside the workspace.
expected: 1) Each case shows its specific message and returns ok false; ENOENT names the executable; failure output redacted and truncated; success saves noteDeploySuccess state. 2) Cancel leaves L3 untouched; accept replaces the document via WorkspaceEdit and records TENANT_CONFIG_APPLIED; out-of-workspace contexts ignored by loadContexts. Needs VS Code host (Tier C).

source: src/lca/deployPlan.ts FUNCTION_NAME check + src/lca/deployPlan.ts + sources.ts isContainedPath + src/lca/deployPlan.ts childEnv, redactCommandOutput
title: Deploy CLI injection, path and secret-output guards
scenario: 1) buildDeployPlan with functionNames 'a; rm -rf /', '--profile evil', 'a b', '$(id)', '-x', '' and a 129-char name. 2) artifactPath '../outside.zip', an absolute path in another dir, the working directory itself, and 'build/app.txt'. 3) childEnv on text with quoted/unquoted values and a value of 8+ chars; redactCommandOutput on output with that value, an AKIA key, password=x and 5000 chars.
expected: 1) All return ok false with the unsupported-characters message; 'hcp.before-save_1' accepted. 2) Outside paths and the directory itself give 'must be a file inside the working directory'; .txt gives 'must be a .jar or .zip file'; traversal never reaches CLI args. 3) secretValues holds only values of 8+ chars; output shows [redacted] per secret and is cut to 2000 chars; shorter values not scrubbed.

source: src/lca/packageName.ts normalizePackageSegment, buildJavaPackage + src/lca/projectPath.ts lcaProjectSlug, lcaProjectDirectory + src/lca/tenantGate.ts locationsFromGitMarker + src/lca/context.ts projectContextFile, LcaContextStore
title: Name, slug, marker and context-file traversal guards
scenario: 1) buildJavaPackage with customerName '../Evil; Corp', typeName 'class', '9Type', '' and blank owner; isForbiddenGenericPackage('com.example.x'). 2) lcaProjectSlug/lcaProjectDirectory with '../../etc', 'a/b', backslashes, all-blank parts. 3) locationsFromGitMarker with l3RelativePath '../outside/BusinessConfig.json', absolute, 'samples/BusinessConfig.json', 'config/other.json', one valid. 4) projectContextFile(dir, '../../evil') and a tenant id with slashes/spaces; write and read back.
expected: 1) Segments [a-z0-9]; keywords and leading digits get 'n' prefix; empty becomes 'lca'; blank owner throws; com.example.* flagged. 2) Slug lowercase [a-z0-9-] ending -lca; no '..' or separators; directory under <tenantRoot>/LifeCycle Actions. 3) Only the valid in-directory file returned; others dropped; invalid JSON marker returns []. 4) Name sanitized to [a-zA-Z0-9._-], stays under <dir>/.reltio/lca-context; mismatched tenantId or directory returns undefined.

title: Tenant discovery is bounded and skips build and dependency folders
scenario: Temp tree with 25 tenant folders, a node_modules copy, and nesting deeper than 8; call discoverTenantL3(root); also from a LifeCycle Actions/<project> subfolder.
expected: Result length is capped at 20; nothing is found under node_modules/.git/dist/target/samples; depth beyond 8 is ignored; project subfolder walks up to its tenant folder.

title: Corrupt or mismatched context file is ignored
scenario: Write garbage JSON to the context path, then valid JSON with another workingDirectory, then valid JSON missing optional fields.
expected: Garbage and mismatched files return undefined without throwing; a partial file is merged over emptyProjectContext and implementationLanguage is forced to Java.
